en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Al Hajjal, from sa’alba, from a man who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A meal of the night is more beneficial than a meal of the day’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hajj al from Tha’labah from a man whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Food during the night is more useful than food during the day.’”
